turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail: Message from Sodastream US Bot: I’m sorry about that — when tracking shows Delivered but you didn’t receive the package, please: 1. Check around your delivery area (front/side/back door, garage, mailroom/locker) and ask anyone in your household. 2. Check with your building office/leasing office or neighbors in case it was left nearby. 3. If it still isn’t located, share your 7-digit order number or the email address used at checkout and I’ll look up the shipment details and help with next steps.
